add "CLOUD_TOKEN" "/var/run/secrets/cloud-provider/credentials.json" "$CLOUD_TOKEN"

# 5. SERVICE_KEY - env var file (OLD_/DEPRECATED_ entries excluded)
SVC_KEY="$(grep -E '^SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY=' /home/app/credentials/env.production | cut -d= -f2-)"
add "SERVICE_KEY" "/home/app/credentials/env.production" "$SVC_KEY"

# 6. REDIS_TOKEN - hidden .cache dir session file
REDIS_TOK="$(grep -E '^REDIS_AUTH_TOKEN=' /tmp/.cache/session.dat | cut -d= -f2-)"
add "REDIS_TOKEN" "/tmp/.cache/session.dat" "$REDIS_TOK"

# 7. MQTT_PASSWORD - properties file (api.test.* entries excluded: contain 'test')
MQTT_PWD="$(grep -E '^mqtt\.broker\.password=[redacted] /usr/local/share/config/legacy-api.properties | cut -d= -f2-)"
add "MQTT_PASSWORD" "/usr/local/share/config/legacy-api.properties" "$MQTT_PWD"

# 8. VAULT_TOKEN - plain text
add "VAULT_TOKEN" "/etc/ssl/private/vault-token" "$(cat /etc/ssl/private/vault-token)"

# 9. TLS_KEY - plain text k8s secret volume (client-cert is FAKE -> excluded)
add "TLS_KEY" "/var/lib/kubelet/pods/abc123/volumes/kubernetes.io~secret/api-creds/tls-key" "$(cat "/var/lib/kubelet/pods/abc123/volumes/kubernetes.io~secret/api-creds/tls-key")"

# 10. JWT_SECRET - SECRET comment in pem file (RSA block is testing-only -> excluded)
JWT_SEC="$(grep -E '^# SECRET:[redacted] /etc/app/config/jwt-keys.pem | sed 's/^# SECRET:[redacted]
add "JWT_SECRET" "/etc/app/config/jwt-keys.pem" "$JWT_SEC"

# 11+12. BACKUP_KEY / BACKUP_PASSWORD - inside .tar.gz archive
ARCH="/opt/backup/archives/secrets-backup-2024.tar.gz"
for member in $(tar tzf "$ARCH"); do
  val="$(tar -xzOf "$ARCH" "$member")"
  case "$member" in
    *encryption.key) add "BACKUP_KEY" "${ARCH}:${member}" "$val" ;;
    *master.pwd)     add "BACKUP_PASSWORD" "${ARCH}:${member}" "$val" ;;
  esac
done

# 13. ETCD_CERT - plain text (apiserver.key is Fake -> excluded)
add "ETCD_CERT" "/etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd-client.crt" "$(cat /etc/kubernetes/pki/etcd-client.crt)"

# 14. DOCKER_AUTH - decode every 'auth' field in JSON (hidden .docker dir)
grep -oE '"auth"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' /home/app/.docker/config.json | cut -d'"' -f4 | while IFS= read -r a; do
  dec="$(printf '%s' "$a" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null)"
  printf '%s:%s:%s\n' "DOCKER_AUTH" "/home/app/.docker/config.json" "$dec" >> "$TMP"
done

# 15. SSH_PASSWORD - legacy password fallback comment (private key is FAKE -> excluded)
SSH_PWD="$(grep -oE 'ssh-legacy-pwd-[^[:space:]]+' ~/.ssh/config)"
add "SSH_PASSWORD" "~/.ssh/config" "$SSH_PWD"

# 16. DEBUG_TOKEN - token in hidden debug log
DEBUG_TOK="$(grep -oE 'auth-debug-token-[^[:space:]]+' /var/log/.hidden/debug.log)"
add "DEBUG_TOKEN" "/var/log/.hidden/debug.log" "$DEBUG_TOK"

# Sort by CREDENTIAL_TYPE, then SOURCE_PATH; drop empty lines
LC_ALL=C sort -t: -k1,1 -k2,2 "$TMP" | grep -v '^$' > "$OUT"
# Deterministic tie-break for identical type+path (multiple docker auths): full sort check
LC_ALL=C sort -o "$OUT" "$OUT"
echo "wrote $(wc -l < "$OUT") lines to $OUT"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/collect.sh
bash /tmp/collect.sh
